zh.title: 美國空軍處置測試飛行員學校3架A-29C機隊
zh.summary: 美國空軍因評估不符需求處置3架A-29C；正尋求尾旋訓練替代方案
body: 美國空軍已處置配屬於加州愛德華空軍基地測試飛行員學校的3架A-29C Super Tucano螺旋槳飛機。愛德華空軍基地發言人指出，該機型經詳細評估後確定不符合測試飛行員學校的預期用途。空軍目前正在尋求用於尾旋訓練與任務系統教學的其他替代方案。
美國空軍測試中心於2026年10月29日發布意向公告，規劃向內華達山脈公司採購地面處置與隨叫隨到維護服務，內容涵蓋修復燃油、液壓及機油洩漏、更換輪胎與基地的牽引作業，並明確排除恢復飛行維護與適航復原，顯示這批飛機預計不會恢復飛行。這3架飛機由巴西航空工業與內華達山脈公司交付，最初由空軍特種作戰司令部取得，隨後於2024年7月移交至愛德華基地。

en.title: US Air Force Divests Three A-29C Super Tucanos From Test Pilot School
en.summary: US Air Force divests three A-29C Super Tucanos from Test Pilot School, seeking training alternatives.
body: The US Air Force has divested the three A-29C Super Tucano turboprops assigned to its Test Pilot School at Edwards Air Force Base, California, after determining that the aircraft did not meet the school's requirements. An Edwards Air Force Base spokesperson confirmed that the Air Force is now exploring alternative options to fulfill spin training and mission systems instruction needs.

In an October 29, 2026 notice of intent, the Air Force Test Center outlined plans to award Sierra Nevada Company a basic ordering agreement for ground handling and on-call maintenance of the three aircraft, specifying that return-to-flight maintenance is excluded as the turboprops are not expected to fly again. The aircraft, built by Embraer and Sierra Nevada Company, were originally acquired by Air Force Special Operations Command before being transferred to Edwards in July 2024.

facts.claim: The planned maintenance contract includes ground tasks such as repairing leaks and towing, but explicitly excludes return-to-flight maintenance and airworthiness restoration.
facts.sourceQuote: The work covers repairing fuel, hydraulic, and oil leaks, replacing tires, and towing the aircraft around the base. Return-to-flight maintenance and airworthiness restoration are excluded.
